summary.text: KERKO EIENDOM AS is a private limited company registered in Bergen, founded 2023-03-15. KERKO EIENDOM AS rents out real estate. Its stated purpose is the purchase, operation and sale of real property ("fst eiendom") and related activities, including participating in other companies with similar activities and buying and selling shares or otherwise taking interests in other enterprises. Its main industry code is 68.200: rental and operating of own or leased real estate. It has 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 74 692 800 NOK and the annual result was 60 006 914 NOK; operating income was up from 72 800 000 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 51 758 333 NOK in 2024 to 60 006 914 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 172 330 615 NOK in 2024 to 171 790 284 NOK in 2025. The register's most recent update was on 2026-07-29 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
